title: Traffic
subtitle: Rate, errors and duration for requests served through the ingress, with no app changes.

referrers.title: Top referrers
referrers.hint: Referring hosts only. Paths and query strings are never stored. Direct means no Referer header.
referrers.label: Referrer
referrers.empty: No referrer data in this window yet.

countries.title: Top countries
countries.hint: Coarse country from a CDN header or a GeoIP database, never stored per client.
countries.label: Country
countries.empty: No country data. Set a GeoIP database or a trusted country header on the ingress to see where traffic comes from.

markers.hint: Vertical lines mark deploys. Select one to see what changed.

slo.title: Error budget
slo.burnHint: 1.0x spends the budget exactly over the SLO period
slo.none: No SLO is set for this app. Add an SLO burn alert to see the error budget here.

replicas.title: Replicas
replicas.hint: Measured per upstream address at the ingress.
replicas.empty: No per replica data yet. It appears once requests reach a container through the ingress.

routes.title: Slowest routes
routes.hint: Route templates only. Ids and query strings are never stored.
routes.empty: No route has enough traffic in this window to rank.

samples.title: Slow and failed requests
samples.hint: A sample of requests that failed or ran slow, kept on the node that served them.
samples.empty: No slow or failed requests were sampled in this window.

empty.title: No traffic in this window
empty.description: Requests show up here once the app is serving through a domain. Try a longer window or check that a domain points at this app.

shield.title: Bot and abuse shield
shield.none: Nothing was turned away in this window. Add per-client limits and a bot blocklist on the domain page to keep scrapers from running up bandwidth.
